jobs.title: Senior Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer
jobs.description: Strong hands-on experience in ASIC or SoC verification Experience verifying mixed-signal blocks or digital-to-analog and analog-to-digital interfaces Strong SystemVerilog skills and practical experience with UVM or an equivalent verification methodology

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description: Extensive experience in RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog) for control logic, datapaths, memory subsystems, and specialized processing units Strong understanding of digital architecture including pipelining, arbitration, memory hierarchy, and system-level integration Proficiency in functional verification including testbench development, assertions, coverage metrics, and debugging
